summary: Implemented the shared CLI result envelope, single top-level exception and exit-code boundary, split stdout/stderr presentation, context-resolution shell, JSON Schema and ADR 0008 fixtures, command rewiring, documentation, and comprehensive CLI tests.
behavior_implemented: Every parsed JSON-capable command emits the strict shared envelope with object-shaped result, structured diagnostics, schema_version, and duration_ms
A root Typer group provides the single runtime exception boundary and maps exit bands 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, and 10 exactly
Typer owns pre-command usage failures at exit 2 while parsed JSON runtime failures emit one stdout envelope plus a sanitized stderr diagnostic
doctor, context init, context inspect, context validate, and the validate alias are rewired; version remains plain text
The shared context option overrides positional and ancestor discovery, missing contexts fail clearly, and the WP-200 registry seam is documented as step 3
Draft 2020-12 schema and Pydantic presentation models are aligned through positive and negative ADR 0008 fixtures
Invalid configuration, aggregated parser failures, secret-looking diagnostics, and unexpected exceptions are sanitized without exposing raw exception content

tests.result: Success: no issues found in 19 source files
Installed entry point help exposed the shared --context option and --json

assumptions: The operator's explicit assignment and supplied ready contract supersede the base-commit copy's stale proposed/PENDING-WAVE0-BASELINE metadata; forbidden metadata was not modified
Typer parsing failures retain native empty-stdout/stderr usage behavior at exit 2 because no parsed JSON command exists yet
decisions: The validate alias uses canonical command identity context.validate
Pydantic CLI envelope models live under the allowed presentation package because src/workctx/models is frozen
CTX-CONFIG and unexpected exceptions use stable generic messages instead of attempting to expose sanitized parser or exception details
security_considerations: Unexpected failures never expose exception text, reprs, causes, locals, or tracebacks
Diagnostics are structured, single-line, bounded, secret-redacted, and rendered without Rich markup interpretation
Aggregated CTX-CONFIG parser snippets are replaced with stable generic text in result.issues and errors
No network access, external writes, secrets, or new dependencies were introduced
migration_considerations: No migration is required because no canonical workspace schema or stored data format changed
recommended_next_action: Implementation lead review of commit b4e7752d337a917d3096ca999e5d09446dbc6f41, report-schema validation, independent full gate, then accept or request revision.
